name: protonmcp
description: Touch-ID-gated Proton Mail access: read, search, organize, draft, and send via the local protonmcpd daemon.
long_description: Touch-ID-gated Proton Mail access via the local protonmcpd daemon. The bundled shim reconnects automatically when the daemon restarts (rebuild, update, crash, or Switch Off/On), so Claude doesn't need to be restarted; requests in flight at that moment return a retryable error.
